title: My Own Prayer
prayer: Holy Father, who are in heaven, I pray that You hear my prayer, and that I may find grace in Your sight. Teach me to be a servant after Your heart, to do everything You want, just as King David did. Give me both the will and the power to do Your will, and may I delight to do Your will. Give me understanding to build myself up as a perfect man before Your eyes, in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen
